set.body: The plugin's hook manifest declares its events at the top level, but the loader reads them from under a top-level hooks record. The file is valid JSON, so nothing complained; the loader simply found no events and every hook silently did nothing for anyone who installed the plugin. Four of four other installed plugins use the wrapper. Incorporated from pull request 329, which found it against a real installation.
set.title: Plugin hooks never fired: the manifest was not wrapped

set.body: While shipping the Codex hooks the wrapper difference was read as a Codex quirk rather than the shared requirement it is, and a test was written asserting that the Claude manifest must not have the wrapper. That pinned the defect in place and would have failed anyone who fixed it.

set.resolution: Hook manifest wrapped; the test that asserted the flat shape corrected. Incorporated from #329.

set.body: v0.22.0 fixed this shape in tests/test_dispatch.py only. At v0.22.1 the same defect is live in three more suites: tests/test_ulid.py (main block at line 107, 9 tests defined below it), tests/test_bug_merge.py (line 412, 4 below) and tests/test_link.py (line 193, 2 below). CI runs each file as a script, so those 15 tests never execute; pytest would import the module and collect them, so the two runners disagree and neither warns. Found during the v0.22.1 design-doc sync. Fix: move each __main__ guard to the end of its file, and add a repo-level assertion that no tests/test_*.py defines a class after its __main__ block.
set.title: Three test suites still hide 15 tests behind a mid-file __main__ block

set.body: The previous release fixed one file whose run-as-a-script block sat in the middle, hiding seven tests, and did not check the other forty. Three more were still hiding fifteen, among them the entire conflict-marker guard suite, which is the regression test for a guard the design documents cite as enforcement. The instance was fixed and the class was not.
set.title: Sweep every test file for the mid-file runner block

set.resolution: All three files swept; a check now fails if any test class is defined below the runner block.
